notes.title: Steel Seed | New Patch + Czech & Turkish Language Support + Roadmap Insights!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/d95d2ef6fbb0378e4dd403f105516714f2d978d6.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

First of all, a massive thank you to all of you for your continued support, feedback, and passion for Steel Seed. Since launch, we’ve been closely listening to your suggestions and analyzing your reports. Today, we’re excited to roll out another update packed with technical improvements, community-requested features, and two new supported languages!

Your feedback continues to shape the future of Steel Seed, and today's patch is another step toward making the game the best experience possible.

[h3]🌐 Language Support Expansion[/h3]
We’re thrilled to announce that Steel Seed is now available in Czech and Turkish! Thank you to our communities in those regions for your patience. We hope this helps more players enjoy the game in their native language. If you encounter any translation inconsistencies, don’t hesitate to let us know via Steam Discussions or our official Discord.

[h3]📊 New Features & Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Improved mission flow in the "Chained Towers" section.
[*] Adjusted damage values for Koby and Zoe’s base attacks.
[*] Fall damage is now disabled in Easy Mode.
[*] Koby’s flight input mapping now opens the selection wheel by default (LB/L1/R key) for both Zoe and Koby.
[*] You can now perform execution attacks on stunned enemies even if their HP is above 30%.
[*] Camera movement during dodging is now smoother around enemies.
[*] Certain in-game dialogues can now be skipped.
[*] The first dialogue now starts after the first cinematic.
[*] Challenges requiring consecutive kills without entering combat now display an in-game counter and persist across fast travel or game closures.
[*] Added a text prompt to clarify the cover button must be held.
[*] Updated visual design of Loot Stations for easier recognition.
[*] Combat VFX optimizations.
[*] Shadow optimizations in the Excavation Node.[/list]
[h3]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed size, noise, and occlusion issues for interactable icons.
[*] Fixed an exploit allowing players to jump outside the path in the Assembly Node.
[*] Fixed a stuck point near an encrypted log in the Hive.
[*] Fixed cover collision issues in the Power Node.
[*] Fixed a climbing ledge in the Excavation Node.
[*] Fixed missing kill volumes in the Power Node's launch station.
[*] Addressed blood decal and animation glitches.
[*] Fixed an energy overflow from Loot Stations.
[*] Resolved sound trigger bugs in the Cenote puzzle.
[*] Fixed ghost dialogue prompts in the S4VI Hub.
[*] Corrected Zoe occasionally speaking in the wrong language in the Assembly Node.
[*] Fixed sound issues in the save/load menus.
[*] Minor audio fixes across the board.[/list]
Special thanks to the community for reporting many of these issues. Your support continues to drive our development forward.

[h3]📆 Looking Ahead: The Steel Seed Roadmap[/h3]
In addition to today’s update, we’d like to offer you a sneak peek at what’s coming next. Here’s what the near future of Steel Seed looks like:
[list][*] [Minor] Patch 1.0.5 - PS5 Controller support and general QoL improvements (Released)
[*] [Minor] Patch 1.0.6 - Game balance adjustments and improvements to overall UX (Released)
[*] [Minor] Patch 1.0.7 - Combat feedback and clarity improvements based on your suggestions. (In Development)
[*] And much more![/list]

Stay tuned as we reveal more details about each upcoming patch. Your feedback is essential as we refine every aspect of the game.

notes.title: Steel Seed (PC) Review
notes.notes:
From its title, Steel Seed, to its premise, aesthetics and gameplay loop, Storm in a Teacup’s latest action-adventure effort could be the most video game-like game of 2025. In other words, Steel Seed feels like a game from another time—namely, the seventh generation of home consoles, which might sound like a slight against the game. Still, sometimes all you really need in life is a good romp through a neon-soaked robot hellscape, playing as one of the last surviving remnants of humanity.

For those who may not have heard of the game, Steel Seed follows the exploits of Zoe and her robot companion, Koby, as they delve (or often slide) deep into the depths of a vast post-apocalyptic world ruled by rogue robots. Steel Seed features a mix of action-oriented combat, stealth sequences peppered between high-octane parkour and cinematic set pieces reminiscent of games like Uncharted and Assassin’s Creed.

In previous diaries, we have shared a lot of information [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/458430/view/523081237389115688?l=english] about the game's world[/url][/b], [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/458430/view/523082504976990278?l=english] about Koby, a flying drone, Zoe's “emotional” companion[/url][/b] and even [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/458430/view/547853571373137938?l=english] about Michael Bay[/url][/b], so today we finally get to talk about the main protagonist — Zoe.

Zoe is the protagonist of Steel Seed. She is a young woman who awakens in a robotic body, stranded in an unfamiliar and dangerous environment. Her journey is one of survival, self-discovery, and a relentless search for her father, all while navigating the psychological toll of loneliness and fear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/164c8d07266f2e04c642c5d3a5c59ccfff7087ec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/f961067877cf5eff0fcbf7d9c50588a75284b479.jpg[/img]

[b]Backstory[/b]

Zoe’s life before the events of Steel Seed remains a mystery to her and the player. At the start of the game, she finds herself trapped in an advanced underground facility, a world dominated by artificial intelligence and robotic entities. With no memory of how or why she was placed in this situation, Zoe struggles to make sense of her transformation into a robotic form and the hostile environment she must  survive.

Her connection to her father is a driving force throughout the story. Despite the uncertainty of his fate, Zoe’s determination to find him fuels her resilience, even as she grapples with overwhelming isolation and fear.

[b]Personality and Traits[/b]

Zoe’s initial state is defined by vulnerability and anxiety. She is terrified and unsure of herself, but her adaptability and inner strength quickly come to the forefront. As the story progresses, Zoe transforms from a frightened survivor into a resourceful and determined individual.

Her robotic body offers her enhanced mobility and abilities, but Zoe struggles to reconcile her humanity with her mechanical form. This internal conflict is a recurring theme in her journey, highlighting her resilience and humanity despite her circumstances.

[b]Appearance and Design[/b]

Zoe’s appearance blends mechanical precision and human relatability, carefully crafted to evoke empathy and connection. Storm in a Teacup drew inspiration from Blame! as a general one and then from iconic characters such as Alita (Battle Angel Alita), Kyashan (Casshern), and Robocop among others. These influences helped shape a protagonist who balances strength and vulnerability with a design that highlights her mechanical nature while retaining clear traces of her humanity. Her expressive eyes and body language were intentionally designed to foster a strong bond between Zoe and the players, making her situation all the more poignant and relatable. The team’s focus was on creating a character who feels both otherworldly and deeply human, immersing players in her emotional journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/cae3ae5d7de240d6d93c5a4da119c01b3d47969e.jpg[/img]

[b]Relationship with Koby[/b]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/458430/view/523082504976990278?l=english]Koby, a prototype drone designed to assist and guide Zoe[/url][/b], becomes her only companion in the facility. While initially perceived as a tool, Koby evolves into a genuine friend and emotional anchor for Zoe. Their bond is central to the narrative, providing moments of lightness, support, and camaraderie amidst the bleakness of their surroundings. Koby’s ability to communicate through chirps and a digital face adds a layer of emotional depth, allowing Zoe to feel less alone in her journey.

[b]Struggles and Themes[/b]

Zoe’s story delves into themes of loneliness, survival, and the essence of humanity. The oppressive and lifeless environment of the facility amplifies her sense of isolation, making her interactions with Koby and her search for her father all the more poignant.

Her robotic body serves as a metaphor for her internal conflict: is she still human, or has she become something else entirely? This existential question drives much of the game’s narrative, as Zoe confronts both external threats and her own identity.

[b]Significance in Steel Seed[/b]

As the central character of Steel Seed, Zoe embodies the emotional core of the game. Her journey invites players to experience the vulnerability and strength of someone thrust into a seemingly impossible situation. Through her, the game explores profound questions about humanity, technology, and the boundaries between the two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/39a1f8446ce169f9b6d5524d569a385cbe6ac78c.jpg[/img]

Zoe’s combination of relatable fear and extraordinary determination makes her a compelling protagonist, one whose story resonates with players on both an emotional and philosophical level.

notes.title: Steel Seed | Dev Diary #3 “MICHAEL BAY SEQUENCES”
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

With [i]Steel Seed[/i] development in full swing, now it's the best time for us to talk about… Michael Bay. Yes, you heard right! We pay tribute to this awesome filmmaker and we'd like to share with you how he inspired us.

Also you can read more about locations in the game and Zoe's companion [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/458430/view/523081237389115688?l=english]here[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/458430/view/523082504976990278?l=english]here[/url][/b], and we're starting!

The action sequences in [i]Steel Seed[/i] are a hallmark of the game’s high-energy, cinematic gameplay, internally referred to by the development team as "Michael Bay Sequences". 

Named after the iconic film director known for his explosive and adrenaline-filled blockbusters, these sequences are designed to deliver spectacular, heart-pounding moments where players must react quickly and think tactically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/9bebe0bda038a30438969d6b1a2d129cb32642a5.jpg[/img]

[b]Design and Intent[/b]

The primary goal of the Michael Bay Sequences is to immerse players in dynamic, high-stakes scenarios that demand quick reflexes and creative problem-solving. Each sequence is a carefully crafted set piece, pushing the boundaries of interactivity and spectacle. By combining intense action with narrative depth, these moments are not only thrilling but also pivotal to the progression of the story. 

[b]Variety and Creativity[/b]

One of the standout features of the Michael Bay Sequences is their variety. Each sequence is distinct from the others, offering players fresh and unpredictable challenges. Whether escaping collapsing environments, engaging in high-speed chases, or navigating massive battles, these moments are designed to keep players on the edge of their seats. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/f4df9cdff1de0cb4ab44d703f50d3601f5f9b0a6.gif[/img]

The development team at Storm in a Teacup embraced the creative freedom of these sequences, describing them as some of the most enjoyable parts of the game’s creation. This enthusiasm shines through in the inventive mechanics and surprising twists that define each set piece. 

[b]Perspective Shifts[/b]

A unique aspect of the Michael Bay Sequences is their use of perspective changes. While the core gameplay of [i]Steel Seed[/i] is presented in a 3D environment, some sequences transform the experience into a 2D perspective, adding a fresh layer of gameplay variety. These shifts are seamlessly integrated into the action, providing players with a new way to engage with the game’s mechanics while amplifying the cinematic feel.

[b]Impact on Gameplay[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/ad974f84d55816f8382fd986cabf28dfe41c3170.gif[/img]

The Michael Bay Sequences are more than just visual spectacles—they serve as critical tests of the player’s mastery of the game’s mechanics. Players must quickly adapt to changing environments, utilize their abilities, and rely on [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/458430/view/523082504976990278?l=english]Koby, Zoe’s drone companion[/url][/b], for guidance and support. These moments highlight the synergy between action and tactics, reinforcing [i]Steel Seed’s[/i] emphasis on thoughtful yet exhilarating gameplay. 

[b]Legacy and Player Experience[/b]

The Michael Bay Sequences aim to leave a lasting impression on players, combining awe-inspiring visuals with intense gameplay challenges. They reflect the game’s commitment to blending cinematic storytelling with interactive depth, offering moments that are as memorable as they are thrilling. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/c5d73c89d1fd52b737d708440dd1e7d90eaaddd4.gif[/img]

These sequences ensure that [i]Steel Seed[/i] stands out not only as a narrative-driven experience but also as a showcase of bold and action design.

notes.title: Steel Seed | Dev Diary #2 “KOBY”
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We shared new info  [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/458430/view/523081237389115688?l=english] about the game's world in the previous diary[/url][/b], so today, we would like to tell you about Koby, a flying drone, Zoe's “emotional” companion. 

Designed by the late scientist Archer, Koby was conceived as a prototype companion drone for the game's protagonist, Zoe. Despite never being physically constructed during Archer's lifetime, Koby's digital blueprint was activated and brought to life as a vital ally in Zoe's journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/3ff8deb9d0c1c4c5e5d09c88ccd555990d94a11a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/226fc851ca29dea8e08df73c8e66cbccb79e788d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/f86277cb2ddb9038d735cad974edc96dd7aec0b2.jpg[/img]

[b]Development and Role[/b]

Koby was created to assist and support Zoe, as outlined by its core programming. However, throughout the adventure, Koby transcends its initial purpose, evolving from a mere helper into a loyal and heartfelt companion. This transformation is integral to the narrative of Steel Seed, emphasizing themes of connection, trust, and the nature of artificial intelligence as it interacts with human emotion.

[b]Personality and Communication[/b]

Koby's "voice" is expressed through a series of chirps, beeps, and electronic tones that resemble speech. These sounds are its primary mode of communication, allowing it to convey information, warn Zoe of danger, and guide her through challenges. While Koby lacks traditional speech, its digital interface—referred to as its "face"—plays a pivotal role in expressing its "feelings."

The face, an animated display, uses various shapes, symbols, and colors to depict emotions such as joy, concern, determination, or sadness. This visual feedback not only deepens the emotional bond between Koby and Zoe but also provides the player with a unique way of interpreting Koby's thoughts and intentions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/734e8457e4f11234070eba15f817654dc74ba2dd.jpg[/img]

[b]Functionality and Features[/b]

Its abilities include analyzing surroundings, detecting hidden paths, and interacting with the environment. Its intuitive AI enables it to adapt to situations, making it a crucial ally during Zoe's journey.

Koby's relationship with Zoe is not merely functional but deeply personal. Over time, the bond between them grows, turning Koby into more than just a tool; it becomes a true friend. This progression highlights the emotional depth of the Steel Seed narrative, as Koby demonstrates care and devotion that go beyond its original programming.

[b]Interaction with Switches, Timers, and Mechanisms[/b]

A key aspect of Koby's utility in Steel Seed is its ability to interact with environmental mechanisms, such as on/off switches and timers. These interactions play a crucial role in solving puzzles and navigating complex areas within the game.

Koby can activate switches on Zoe’s command. This ability allows the duo to manipulate doors, platforms, and other elements critical to progressing through the game.

Timers add an additional layer of challenge, requiring Zoe to perform precise, time-sensitive tasks. The interplay between Koby’s actions and Zoe’s movements enhances the game’s strategy and highlights the cooperative bond between the two.

These interactions further showcase Koby's advanced programming, demonstrating not only its technical prowess but also its ability to work seamlessly with Zoe to overcome obstacles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/246ad41044ca74afae07b24e8c7c365cf9c5db4c.gif[/img]

[b]Legacy[/b]

Koby's design and characterization reflect Archer's vision of creating a companion that embodies empathy and ingenuity. Its story serves as a testament to the enduring impact of human creativity, even in the face of loss, and underscores the game's exploration of humanity's relationship with technology and artificial intelligence.

notes.title: Steel Seed | Dev Diary #1 “The Facility”
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/a57682a538a11a29788fcbc61d2dddb7312806ce.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

We’ve been quiet about Steel Seed for a while now, but we are happy to say that the game's development is progressing at a steady pace. You will start seeing much more of Steel Seed in the near future, and it is high time we share a bit more in-depth look at the world of Steel Seed — so we are pleased to present you with a series of dev diaries. Today, we will share more info about the locations in the world of Steel Seed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/d92dc05d0ac316679caa773afaedb5a5bdd75d0b.jpg[/img]

The Facility is a gigantic structure created by machines after the AIs decided to take the lead in saving humanity after a traumatic cataclysm made the environment inhabitable. Since it was realized by machines to be used by machines, the facility is not a place where humans can feel confident moving around. However, Zoe, the main protagonist, will have to learn how to deal with it quickly if she wishes to survive and find answers through her journey.

The facility serves as the primary setting for the game and is divided into four distinct areas and a central hub: the Assembly Node, Excavation Node, Power Node, Biological Node, and S4VI Hub. Each location has unique characteristics and environments that reflect its specific purpose within the facility’s operation. The S4VI Hub acts as the central nexus, connecting all other nodes and serving as a key location for progression and exploration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/7047ff2a1765833f0ca504e987e42aee7952f296.jpg[/img]

The Assembly Node is the heart of the facility’s manufacturing and production systems. This area is dominated by towering machinery, conveyor belts, and automated assembly lines that continuously construct and repair the facility’s mechanical components. The atmosphere is industrial and highly active, with a cacophony of clanking metal, grinding gears, and sparks flying from automated welding arms.

Players navigating the Assembly Node must contend with moving platforms, rotating mechanisms, and environmental hazards such as molten metal spills and crushing presses. This area challenges players to master timing and precision while highlighting the facility’s intended capability for self-repair and innovation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/00cf6bc30ff7488cbeca92001f26767ff0651658.jpg[/img]

The Excavation Node is a vast, open-air mining area dedicated to extracting crystals from which Glitch Energy can be obtained. Towering drills and mining rigs dominate the landscape, with clusters of luminous crystals embedded in rocky outcrops. A river of petrol snakes through the area, its dark surface shimmering under the dim light of the mining operations.

Players navigating the Excavation Node must contend with guarded outposts, environmental hazards, and malfunctioning equipment. The open nature of this area offers vertical exploration opportunities, requiring players to interact with zip lines, mining lifts, and drilling platforms. The Excavation Node highlights the facility’s reliance on rare resources to sustain its advanced systems and the dangers of exploiting the environment to do so.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/2c57366df5a0e029ffeba4cda9c28d139462ef5b.jpg[/img]

The Power Node is the facility’s energy center, responsible for generating and distributing power to all other areas. This node is characterized by towering reactors, glowing energy conduits, and huge pulsating power cores. The environment is electrified, with arcs of energy crackling through the air and a deep hum resonating throughout the space.

Players must traverse hazardous areas filled with high-voltage discharges, overheating machinery, and mechanisms controlling the facility’s power flow. The Power Node emphasizes the facility's immense energy demands and the delicate balance required to maintain its operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/3ee1532912485818826de44cdd8da990aafeb285.jpg[/img]

The Biological Node is a lush, biodome-like environment designed to sustain organic life. This area features dense vegetation, flowing water, and artificial sunlight that mimics natural ecosystems. It serves as a stark contrast to the mechanical and industrial aesthetics of the other nodes, offering a tranquil yet mysterious atmosphere.

This node is not without its dangers, as it is the most important node for all the AIs and robots that are active in the facility. Navigating the Biological Node involves solving environmental puzzles, interacting with the ecosystem, and uncovering secrets about the facility’s efforts to preserve life. The area reflects the facility’s role in balancing technological advancement with the conservation of biological diversity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/9a77c9b899a09e4ba414d3aef6b00a8043c1e7c3.jpg[/img]

The S4VI Hub is the central nexus of the facility, connecting all other nodes. This area serves as a safe zone for players. Here, players can interact with the S4VI AI, a central intelligence responsible for managing the facility’s operations. The S4VI points scattered around the facility are linked to the hub, which is why they allow players to upgrade abilities, acquire ammos, and access previously explored areas of the facility. The S4VI HUB also serves as a narrative focal point, revealing crucial information about the facility’s origins and purpose.

The Facility in Steel Seed represents a blend of technological ingenuity and environmental diversity, offering players a dynamic and immersive setting to explore. Each node presents unique challenges and storytelling opportunities, while the S4VI Hub provides a vital link that ties the entire experience together.

notes.title: Steel Seed — New Gameplay Trailer and Partnership Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]ESDigital Games [/b]is thrilled to announce a new publishing deal with developer [b]Storm in a Teacup[/b] to publish their stealth action-adventure game Steel Seed for PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S in late 2024. ESDigital Games will showcase the first public gameplay demo of Steel Seed on their booth at GDC Play from 20-22 March. 
[b]Watch New Gameplay Trailer below![/b]

[previewyoutube=rfw7V_lKixM;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]“From the first time we saw Steel Seed, we knew that the talented team at Storm in a Teacup had a great concept for their take on the stealth action-adventure genre”[/i] commented Oleg Kudishov, CEO of ESDigital Games.[i]“We are excited to be partnering with industry veteran Carlo Ivo Alimo Bianchi and his team on this project and look forward to sharing their vision with gamers across the world.”[/i]

Here's what players can expect from [b]Steel Seed[/b]:
[list]
[*] [b]Immersive, dark sci-fi world [/b]— intriguing main character evolution paired with a compelling and deep narrative experience revised and edited by BAFTA-winning writer Martin Korda. 
[*] [b]Stealth: the art of fighting, without fighting [/b] —  Use stealth-based techniques to explore the facility’s hostile environment undetected by robotic entities and guards. Some confrontations can be avoided through efficient movement. 
[*] [b]Dynamic gameplay[/b] — When exploring the environment, use Zoe’s powerful arsenal of tools and weapons to hone your own gameplay style. Discover new gadgets on your journey and unlock new skills for KOBY. 
[*] [b]Intense combat[/b] —  Test your reflexes and multitasking abilities in Steel Seed’s challenging fast-paced combat action. Dodge enemy attacks and deliver punishing blows to clear the path. Call on KOBY’s special gadgets and actions to cover you in combat and neutralise threats.
[*] [b]Unique levels, unique challenges[/b] — Every level inside the facility is unique and offers many challenges for Zoe and KOBY to overcome. 
[*] [b]Mobility[/b] —  Use Zoe’s parkour skills to traverse the underground facility and gain a tactical advantage. From the artificial, robot-controlled depths to the open natural environment, danger lurks around every corner. 
[*] [b]A powerful guide[/b] — Take control of KOBY by entering Flight Mode. Scan the area to discover secret areas, detect enemy positions, and find new upgrades for Zoe. Or maybe… use him as bait.
[*] [b]KOBY, a drone for life[/b] — The master key of Steel Seed and Zoe’s guide on her lonely and dangerous journey inside the underground facility. By working together, they create a formidable duo and bring something new to every fight. 
[/list]

Stay tuned for more!
